extensionName.message: Kotoba Uke Mimamori | A Gentle Pause for Words on X

extensionDescription.message: A Chrome extension that adds a gentle pause before reading potentially harmful words on X.

cushionBody.message: This post may contain expressions that could place an emotional burden on the reader.

reasonExistenceDenial.message: This may contain wording close to existence denial.

reasonPersonalityAttack.message: This may contain wording close to a personality attack.

reasonDiscriminatoryAttack.message: This may contain wording close to an attribute-based attack.

reasonSevereInsult.message: This may contain wording close to a severe insult.

reasonPersistentAttack.message: This may contain wording that could feel pressuring.

reasonThreatOrHarm.message: This may contain wording that could raise safety concerns.

reasonDoxxingOrPrivacyRisk.message: This may contain wording related to personal information or safety.

reasonGeneric.message: Potentially emotionally burdensome wording was detected.

reasonPotentialBurden.message: This may contain wording that could place an emotional burden on the reader.

optionsDescription.message: Settings for adding a gentle pause before reading words that arrive on X.

optionSensitivityLowDescription.message: Shows cushions mainly for stronger expressions.

optionSensitivityHighDescription.message: Shows cushions more easily for slightly lighter risk expressions.

optionPrivacyNote.message: Post text and detection results are not sent externally.

optionStorageNote.message: Settings are stored in this browser.

optionReloadNote.message: ON/OFF and display sensitivity changes will take effect after reloading the open X page.
